Hi Aisha / Victor — thanks again for your time today. Quick recap from our discovery and a few asks so we can move to a mutual action plan: 

Call highlights (30 min):
- Use case: near-real-time triage + indexing of EHR notes (low PII exposure).
- Volume: ~25M tokens/month initially; typical inference patterns: many short queries (avg 80 tokens).
- Must-haves: SOC2 + audit logs; legal needs sample DPA language; finance needs PO or card capability.

Open items / asks: 
1) Procurement path: you mentioned your procurement team prefers a PO, but there was interest in marketplace to speed up the first purchase. Can you confirm which procurement instrument you want to pursue for the initial 6–12 month commitment (PO vs. Marketplace card)?
2) Timeline: please confirm high-level gating durations for Legal review, Security questionnaire (SSG/SaaS questionnaires), Finance approval, and expected PO issuance or marketplace payment window.
3) Deliverables we should send now: draft SOW + pricing worksheet + our security evidence index. I attached a one-page commercial-path worksheet for you to share internally.

Next steps I propose:
- If PO route: we prepare a short SOW + final pricing and an MPA draft for Legal to review.
- If marketplace route: push pricing + monthly plan + marketplace billing link and aim to go-live in 5–7 business days.

Can you reply with the procurement preference and estimated lead times for each gate? Happy to set a short alignment call with your legal/finance next week.

Thanks,

Thanks Jordan — useful recap. Quick answers from our side: 

Procurement preference: PO is the default for enterprise deals; however, our product team has asked us to evaluate marketplace for a fast pilot. For an initial pilot with standard security posture, marketplace would be faster (3–7 business days to onboard). For production (6–12 mo) we will likely convert to PO.

Estimated gating timeline (best guess):
- Legal (contract & DPA review): ~10 business days after receiving SOW + commercial terms (depends on redlines).
- Security questionnaire (we use a vendor questionnaire + evidence request): 3–7 business days to complete if evidence is provided promptly.
- Finance approval & PO issuance: 7–10 business days after Legal signs off; PO is typically issued in Net 30 terms.

Key asks for us to progress: 
- Please send a short SOW and the pricing worksheet (line-item pricing and annualized token estimate).
- Security evidence index (SOC2 report, retention policy, audit log location).

I attached a short internal checklist (procurement-path-notes.pdf) — I've also looped Victor (Finance) to confirm PO cadence.

Happy to join a call with Legal/Finance early next week. Proposed times: Tue 8/4 9–11am PT or Wed 8/5 1–3pm PT.

Best,
Aisha Khan
Senior PM, Integrations | MedSys Health
